objective: Run the frozen census and test the frozen predictions of research/MISSING-KNOTS-20261112-001/preregistration.md.
status: Closed: refuted 2026-11-12 (frozen, exact; referee pending). A fixed unit per missing knot is refuted: on newest-four growth the slope replicates (0.098 to 0.118, M1 held) but on the Bernoulli band it falls with density to 0.088 (M2 failed; the rival M2r held at 0.795), and within bases missing knots fail to predict the bond at low closing rates (M3 failed: -0.23 at q = 0). M remains the steadiest count tried (CV 9.6%).
title: The frozen census
